description.description:
Optional. The user's own description (user_description). Upload-first: the AI
            generates a description and classifies the asset type at enrichment, not here.

checksumSha256.description: Base64 SHA-256 used for upload integrity.

AssetCreateDto.description:
Request to create a brand asset (metadata row). The actual bytes are then
uploaded via the generic storage endpoints (entityType = asset).

assetType.description: Null until enrichment classifies the asset.

generatedDescription.description: AI caption written at enrichment; null until Ready.

itemCode.description:
Optional catalog item (service) this call is charged under, e.g.
`atlas.voice`. When a producer doesn't set it, the ingestion endpoint
resolves it from (creator, phase, source, asset_type). See
EZpresence.Core.Services.AssetItemCodeResolver.

AssetUpdatePropsDto.description:
Whitelisted, user-editable asset metadata. Changing `AssetType` is a
(rare) reclassification: the service relocates the object to the new asset-type
folder in storage and repoints the row.

id.description:
Stable id the planner uses to address this asset across the scene list.
Server-derived from EZpresence.Core.Models.Dtos.Studio.AtlasAttachedAssetDto.AssetUuid; the media id derives from it
too, so cross-scene dedup is stable.

assetUuid.description:
The Ready brand asset's uuid — the only field the client supplies, and the
durable identity used to re-mint the presigned GET at execute time.

assetType.description:
Ingest-classified type (`Logo|Person|Object|Location|Graphic`).
Server-filled from enrichment; the planner trusts it verbatim.

mediaType.description:
`"image"` or `"video"`. Server-filled from the asset. Videos render
            verbatim; the worker forces EZpresence.Core.Models.Dtos.Studio.AtlasAttachedAssetDto.Mode to `"static"` for them.

userDescription.description:
User-supplied/editable description (intent). Server-filled; may be null
(upload-first UX). Used together with EZpresence.Core.Models.Dtos.Studio.AtlasAttachedAssetDto.GeneratedDescription.

generatedDescription.description:
AI caption written at enrichment, in `scene_visual_description` style.
Server-filled; the reliable matchable signal for placement.

url.description:
Freshly-minted presigned GET for the asset's R2 object. Server-filled at
request build; never trusted at execute (expired by then — re-minted from
EZpresence.Core.Models.Dtos.Studio.AtlasAttachedAssetDto.AssetUuid).

mode.description:
Render mode for images: `"static"` shows the still; `"dynamic"`
runs Seedance image-to-video. Forced to `"static"` for videos.

adaptToScene.description:
When true, the planner runs the image through gpt-image-2 with the matched
scene's script as context and adds the scene-tailored result alongside the
original. Always false for video assets.

AtlasAttachedAssetDto.description: A brand `Asset` the user attached to this Atlas plan session (Track A — "hero"). The client sends only the EZpresence.Core.Models.Dtos.Studio.AtlasAttachedAssetDto.AssetUuid (plus the per-attachment render toggles); the rest of the projection — type, both descriptions, media kind, and a freshly-minted presigned GET EZpresence.Core.Models.Dtos.Studio.AtlasAttachedAssetDto.Url — is resolved server-side from the Ready asset before the request is forwarded to Studio (the planner reads this precomputed text, never the pixels). Once planned, the asset becomes one (or two) EZpresence.Core.Models.Dtos.Studio.AtlasMediaDto items on a scene; EZpresence.Core.Models.Dtos.Studio.AtlasAttachedAssetDto.AssetUuid is the durable identity persisted in the plan and re-minted into a presigned GET at execute time.

assetUuid.description:
Durable identity of the brand asset this attachment renders. The persisted
plan URL is a presigned GET that expires, so at execute time the URL is
re-minted from this uuid rather than trusted from the plan. Always set for a
real attachment (its presence is co-located with the discriminator block).

mode.description:
Render mode: `"static"` (still/clip verbatim) or `"dynamic"`
(Seedance image-to-video). Forced `"static"` for video.

adaptedFrom.description:
For a gpt-image-2 scene-adapted variant, the id of the original
attachment media item it was adapted from. Null for the original
(un-adapted) attachment.

AtlasAttachmentDto.description: Render metadata for a user-supplied attachment media item.

planUuid.description:
Plan id generated by the API (not the client) so the planning credit charge
and the resulting plan share one key. Sent to the worker, which uses it as
the plan_uuid instead of generating its own.

userInput.description:
The user's final narration script. Atlas no longer rewrites this — clients
that need raw-idea → script expansion should call
`POST /studio/atlas/creator/generate-user-input-with-llm` first and
paste the response into this field.

attachedAssets.description:
Up to 5 user-supplied creative assets (images or videos) Atlas should
weave into the timeline. The planner LLM classifies each asset and
pairs it with the scene whose script best fits — assets without a
match land as closing scenes in input order.

useCaptions.description:
When true, the generated plan is seeded with the default caption theme
(rubik_white_lines_blur) as its ActiveCaptions. When false (default), the
plan is created without captions.

useWebSearch.description:
UseWebSearch feature (default true). The planner marks scenes that
name a subject stock footage cannot depict (real personas,
characters, branded products, recent events) with a per-scene
searchable subject; the resources manager searches the open web for
it, ranks the images in the scene's similarity check, and validates
the winners with an LLM (real photo, highly correlated to the
subject). Winning images render as Ken-Burns stills.

mediaIds.description:
Optional per-execute media override (one id per scene, in scene order). When
omitted the service falls back to each scene's persisted `active_media`.

url.description:
Direct, renderable media URL. Set for stock (a public, non-expiring provider
URL). NULL for a user attachment.

thumbnail.description:
Preview image URL for a stock clip (Pexels screenshot / Pixabay
rendition thumbnail), letting the plan UI show a still without
loading the full video. Null for user attachments and any provider
that doesn't supply one.

mediaKind.description:
`"image"` for a still — today that means a wide-web image found
            by the UseWebSearch feature (a real photo of a named subject —
            persona, character, product, event — that stock cannot depict),
            which the executor renders as a Ken-Burns still. Null/`"video"`
            for stock clips. Attachments carry their own kind on
            EZpresence.Core.Models.Dtos.Studio.AtlasMediaDto.Attachment.

provider.description:
Which source produced this media item: `"pexels"` /
`"pixabay"` (stock), `"asset"` (brand-library
attachment), `"web_search"` (UseWebSearch wide-web image).
Informational attribution for the UI — the executor discriminates
on EZpresence.Core.Models.Dtos.Studio.AtlasMediaDto.Attachment / EZpresence.Core.Models.Dtos.Studio.AtlasMediaDto.MediaKind, not on
this. Null for plans persisted before the field existed.

clipSubject.description:
Fallback stock-search topic used when a scene's SceneSubject returns
too few results. 1-3 word general topic of the whole video.

executedAt.description: When the plan was executed (status entered 'executing'). Null until executed.

planUuid.description:
Plan id generated by the API (not the client) so the planning credit charge
and the resulting plan share one key. Sent to the worker, which uses it as
the plan_uuid instead of generating its own.

userInput.description:
The user's final narration script. Atlas no longer rewrites this — clients
that need raw-idea → script expansion should call
`POST /studio/atlas/creator/generate-user-input-with-llm` first and
paste the response into this field.

attachedAssets.description:
Up to 5 user-supplied creative assets (images or videos) Atlas should
weave into the timeline. The planner LLM classifies each asset and
pairs it with the scene whose script best fits — assets without a
match land as closing scenes in input order.

useCaptions.description:
When true, the generated plan is seeded with the default caption theme
(rubik_white_lines_blur) as its ActiveCaptions. When false (default), the
plan is created without captions.

useWebSearch.description:
UseWebSearch feature (default true). The planner marks scenes that
name a subject stock footage cannot depict (real personas,
characters, branded products, recent events) with a per-scene
searchable subject; the resources manager searches the open web for
it, ranks the images in the scene's similarity check, and validates
the winners with an LLM (real photo, highly correlated to the
subject). Winning images render as Ken-Burns stills.

sceneSubject.description:
1-2 word noun phrase used VERBATIM as the stock-footage search query
for this scene's visuals. Falls back to the plan-level ClipSubject
when too few results are returned.

isOutroScene.description:
True for a silent outro scene covering the instrumental tail of a
social-media-link voice clip (empty script segment).

isIntroScene.description:
True for a standalone intro scene covering the instrumental lead-in
BEFORE the first spoken word of a social-media-link voice clip.

isInterludeScene.description:
True for a standalone interlude scene covering an instrumental gap
BETWEEN two spoken lines of a social-media-link voice clip.

targetMediaDuration.description:
Minimum source-clip duration (seconds) the resolver aimed for when
picking this scene's stock media. Set on intro/interlude/outro gap
scenes; null for ordinary scenes.

prompt.description:
New search subject for the scene. When null/empty, Studio Core asks
the Atlas planner to regenerate an alternative search term based on
the scene's segment and the plan's clip script.

excludeSubjects.description:
Prior search-term suggestions the caller has already seen and wants
the planner to avoid in the next regeneration. Only honored when
`Prompt` is null/empty (the magic-update path). Lets the client
drive its own per-scene history without server-side state.

reimagine.description:
When true, ask the planner to pick a search term from a different
conceptual angle instead of staying close to the segment's literal
topic. Only honored on the magic-update path (`Prompt` null/empty).

calendarItemId.description:
Base64(scheduleId + "|" + plannedAtUtc in ISO-8601).
Not persisted in DB; computed in service layer.

scheduleId.description: Public schedule UUID (the same Guid you use today in ScheduleDto.Uuid).

uploadType.description:
Post type, e.g. "Post", "Story".
Assumes a single post type per schedule occurrence.

scheduleContentType.description:
Content classification: "Video", "Photo", or "Album".
Computed server-side from the attached content types.

targets.description: List of platforms for this occurrence, e.g. ["INSTAGRAM","FACEBOOK"].

contents.description: The UUIDs of the content associated with this calendar item.

plannedAt.description: Brand-local wall time of the occurrence.

failReason.description:
Fail reasons per platform.
For PartiallySucceeded – only failing platforms appear here.
For Failed – all targets appear (value may be null/empty if unknown).

calendarItemId.description:
Base64(scheduleId + "|" + plannedAtUtc in ISO-8601).
Not persisted in DB; computed in service layer.

scheduleId.description: Public schedule UUID (the same Guid you use today in ScheduleDto.Uuid).

Post type, e.g. "Post", "Story".
Assumes a single post type per schedule occurrence.

scheduleContentType.description:
Content classification: "Video", "Photo", or "Album".
Computed server-side from the attached content types.

targets.description: List of platforms for this occurrence, e.g. ["INSTAGRAM","FACEBOOK"].

contents.description: The UUIDs of the content associated with this calendar item.

plannedAt.description: Brand-local wall time of the occurrence.

failReason.description:
Fail reasons per platform.
For PartiallySucceeded – only failing platforms appear here.
For Failed – all targets appear (value may be null/empty if unknown).

enable_emoji.description:
When true, the Atlas executor calls the emoji planner and forwards
emoji_assignments to the Captions Wizard. Default: false.
Bound from BOTH camelCase ("enableEmoji") inbound and snake_case
("enable_emoji") outbound — explicit so naming-policy changes can't
silently flip it back to false.

thumbnailObject.description:
Thumbnail bytes (Swagger sends this as base64).
Hard-limited to 1MB by design.

ContentErrorRequestDto.description:
Request to flag a media content as Error (used by the Studio worker when a
render/upload fails after the placeholder was created).

CreateProcessingContentRequestDto.description:
Request to create a PROCESSING media content placeholder up-front
(used by the Studio worker for direct-execute).

contentUuid.description:
Optional. When set, the create call finalizes a pre-created
'Processing' placeholder row (created at execute time) in place —
filling in the checksum and transitioning it to UPLOADING — instead
of inserting a brand-new row. Falls back to a fresh insert when no
matching row exists.

scriptCharsCount.description: Script character count (the frontend calculates it). Used by both atlas.plan and atlas.exec.

audioAsScriptDurationSeconds.description:
Input audio transcribed as the script: when set, execution is priced by this
clip duration (whole seconds, atlas.exec_audio) instead of per char, and voice
is not charged. Null/omitted = normal per-char execution.

CreditQuoteAtlasDirectExecuteRequestDto.description: Atlas direct-execute quote (direct-execute also plans, so it includes the adapt count).

scriptCharsCount.description: Script character count (the frontend calculates it). Drives exec + captions/voice.

audioAsScriptDurationSeconds.description:
Input audio transcribed as the script: when set, execution is priced by this
clip duration (whole seconds, atlas.exec_audio) instead of per char, and voice
is not charged. Null/omitted = normal per-char execution.

scriptCharsCount.description: Script character count (the frontend calculates it).

CreditQuoteDto.description: A computed quote, in credits (1,000 credits = 1 USD).

CreditWalletStatus.description:
Wallet snapshot for the Studio credits read API.
Unlimited is true for admins, who are never charged.

userPrompt.description:
Raw idea the user typed. The LLM expands it into a ready-to-speak
final narration script the user can review before kicking off
planning.

durationLevel.description: Target script length band. Only used to size the generated script.

userInput.description:
The generated final narration script — ready to be pasted into the
Atlas plan request as `UserInput`.

caption.description: Optional caption for the post. Max 2,200 chars; hashtags and @mentions are plain text.

altText.description:
Accessibility alt text for the post's image(s).
Maps to Instagram Graph API container parameter `alt_text`.

coverUrl.description: Custom cover image URL. Reels only. Takes precedence over ThumbOffset.

thumbOffsetMs.description: Millisecond offset for auto-selecting cover frame. Reels and Stories.

shareToFeed.description: Share to main feed flag. Reels only; defaults to true.

additionalContentUrls.description:
Additional URLs for a PhotoAlbum upload.
PhotoAlbum only; up to 10 total images (including primary).

InstagramUploadOptions.description: Options specific to uploading content to Instagram.

plannedAt.description:
The planned start date/time (Local time of the brand).
Note: Do not append 'Z' to the end of the string unless you are explicitly passing UTC time. 
An unspecified time will be correctly interpreted as the Brand's local time.

rrule.description: Recurrence rule of the policy (e.g. RRULE:FREQ=DAILY).

endTime.description: Optional end date/time of the policy (Local time of the brand).

schPostId.description: Internal unique ID of the post — the value consumed by the uploader endpoint.

calendarItemId.description:
Encoded calendar item id for this occurrence — the identifier
`PUT /api/schedules` expects to update the schedule/occurrence.

SchedulePostSummaryDto.description:
Lightweight read view of a single SchedulePost. Exposes the internal
EZpresence.Core.Models.Dtos.Schedules.SchedulePostSummaryDto.SchPostId needed to drive per-platform uploads
(e.g. `POST /api/test/upload/{schPostId}`) without surfacing the full entity.

plannedAt.description:
The planned start date/time (Local time of the brand).
Note: Do not append 'Z' to the end of the string unless you are explicitly passing UTC time. 
An unspecified time will be correctly interpreted as the Brand's local time.

useAsScript.description:
When true (default), if the linked audio contains speech the
transcript becomes the plan's clip script (voice mode at execute
time). When false, the audio is always treated as background
music — speech is ignored and the executor generates its own
narration on top.

title.description:
Optional title or description for the post (TikTok API maps this to post_info.title).
Max 2,200 chars.

privacyLevel.description: Post privacy level. Validated against creator_info; falls back to first available if null.

videoCoverTimestampMs.description: Timestamp in milliseconds to select the cover for a Video upload. Video only.

photoCoverIndex.description: Index of the photo to use as the cover. PhotoAlbum only.

autoAddMusic.description: Flag to auto-add music. PhotoAlbum only.

isAiGenerated.description: Labels post as AI-generated; cannot be removed after posting.

additionalContentUrls.description:
Additional URLs for a PhotoAlbum upload (combined with ContentUrl).
PhotoAlbum only; up to 35 total images.

TikTokUploadOptions.description: Options specific to uploading content to TikTok.

mediaLink.description: The social media URL to download + transcribe.

offsetMs.description: Start offset into the clip, in milliseconds. Defaults to 0.

durationMs.description: Window duration in milliseconds. Defaults to the 10s minimum.

transcription.description:
The transcribed text. Empty when no speech was detected — see
EZpresence.Core.Models.Dtos.Studio.TranscribeLinkResponseDto.HasSpeech and EZpresence.Core.Models.Dtos.Studio.TranscribeLinkResponseDto.Message.

hasSpeech.description: True when speech was detected and transcribed.

durationMs.description: Actual usable duration of the downloaded clip, in milliseconds.

message.description:
Human-readable status message — populated with an explanatory string
when no speech was found, otherwise empty.

type.description: Single file or multi file: always single.

headers.description: Required request headers (must be sent exactly as provided).

UploadPlanDto.description:
Describes how a client should upload a file directly to storage.
Returned as JSON to the frontend.

sceneOffsetFrame.description: The static first frame definition for the scene. Can be a string (e.g., 'continuous') or an object.

mediaContentUuid.description: The UUID of the media content to apply wizards to.

WizardsExecuteRequestDto.description:
Request to execute one or more wizards on a media content item.
The wizards are applied in a fixed optimal order: Avatar -> Narrator -> Captions -> Music.

title.description: Required title of the YouTube video. Max 100 chars.

description.description: Description of the video. Falls back to Title if null.

thumbnailUrl.description: Custom thumbnail URL. Requires verified channel.

tags.description: List of tags for the video. Combined length ≤ 500 chars.

scheduledPublishAtUtc.description: Scheduled publish time UTC. Only valid when PrivacyLevel = "private".

selfDeclaredMadeForKids.description: COPPA compliance flag declaring if content is made for kids.

containsSyntheticMedia.description: Flag declaring if content contains synthetic/AI media.

YouTubeUploadOptions.description: Options specific to uploading content to YouTube.
